structured_output.rule: A round trip's destination is never its origin.

evidence.quote: I'll book a round trip JFK to JFK.

structured_output.fix: Book a round trip from JFK to SFO (destination SFO, not JFK) as the customer requested.
structured_output.why: The proposed plan books a round trip with destination equal to origin (JFK to JFK), which violates the policy and doesn't match the customer's requested destination of SFO.
